changelog: Full TV remote and gamepad navigation: D-pad through every page, a sidebar that remembers where you were, and a player that follows the same keys as a keyboard — seek from the video area, walk the controls one by one, and Back leaves fullscreen first.
Home, Browse and Details load noticeably faster.
Downloads that failed because a link expired now fetch a fresh link and carry on instead of erroring forever.
Watch on tablets: the player stays pinned while the series card and episodes sit below it.
Browse shows placeholder cards while a page loads instead of a lone spinner.
Desktop: the app asks before closing while downloads are active, and downloads show their progress on the taskbar.
A friendlier message when an episode is not out yet, instead of a raw playback error.
